item.title: NWS Houston / Galveston – Widespread Freezing Again Tonight
item.description: Another round of below freezing temperatures for most of Southeast Texas tonight with northern areas experiencing a hard freeze. There is potential for freezing fog in our southwestern areas. Chilly temperatures tomorrow with highs in the 40s/50s.
